fields.FIR_Description: It was alleged that an online seller collected an advance of Rs. 7,500 for a product and then blocked the number of the complainant. The matter was brought to Thoothukudi Port PS on 2025-10-08, while the incident was placed on 2025-10-07 at approximately 11:20. Dinesh Balan (9000000363), described as an intermediary, was also mentioned in the complaint. Abirami Sri (9000000096) noticed the incident and may be able to provide a statement. The complainant mentioned the account SYN-ACC-100034 as the destination of the transfer. A person named Rajesh Karuppasamy, associated with the number 9000000318, was mentioned as potentially relevant to the incident. Items referenced in the complaint: digital documents and a bank transaction reference.
fields.Modus_Operandi: Fake shopping page allegedly used to collect payments.
fields.Keywords: online shopping fraud, fake seller, mobile number, morning, digital document, residential colony, witness, receiving account
